items.title: Harold Mabern interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, March 31, 2010
items.q: He was the wonderful trombonist that went to school at Howard University with Benny Golson and Eddie Jones.

ctx.x: Did you do any of the blues gigs on the south side or was that not something you pursued?

No. Well strange enough, I worked a lot in a big band on the south side with the Morris Ellis Big Band. He was the wonderful trombonist that went to school at Howard University with Benny Golson and Eddie Jones. He used to play up in Count Basie’s band. And so that’s how I got my little bit of big band training, by playing in a big band. And the charts were kind of, you know for somebody self-taught, they weren’t really too easy, but I was able to hang in there and get the experience that I needed. And after that…
Yeah. What was the pay scale back in Chicago in those days. What kind of money would you make on a gig?
